title: exquisite golden australian toor dal
description: a rich and gooey toor dal dish, perfect for a weekend brunch
instructions: heat the coconut oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
add the turmeric, coriander, cumin, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1-2 minutes.
add the toor dal, water, and salt, and bring to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the dal is tender.
use a potato masher or the back of a spoon to mash the dal slightly to create a creamy texture.
transfer the dal to a serving dish and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro.
for the temper, heat a small pan over medium heat and add a tablespoon of coconut oil.
add a few strands of fresh cilantro and a pinch of salt and cook until crispy.
use the temper as a garnish for the dal.
